who_we_are.heading: We don’t just make stationery. We help shape bright futures.
body: Grade is a proudly Bangladesh brand dedicated to empowering every learner to reach their potential.
We create dependable, innovative and high-quality stationery that makes learning, creating and everyday tasks easier and more enjoyable.
From the first pencil to important presentations, our products are designed to inspire confidence, spark creativity and support better performance—every step of the way.

image.alt: Warehouse racking stacked with palletised cartons

categories_intro.heading: Five ranges, supplied by the carton.

pillars.title: Empowerment
pillars.body: Every line exists to put capability in someone’s hands — the pencil a child learns to write with, the file that holds a day’s work together.

pillars.title: Innovation
pillars.body: We look for the better version of an ordinary thing: break-resistant lead, ink that does not skip on recycled paper, a grip that survives a long exam.

pillars.title: Reliability
pillars.body: The reorder matches the first order. Specification, pack size and finish stay exactly where we said they would.

pillars.title: Continuous Improvement
pillars.body: More than a decade in the category means we keep revising — a hexagonal barrel, a jam-resistant rail, a jar that keeps erasers clean.

pillars.title: Customer First
pillars.body: Schools, retailers and offices buy on trust and timing. We answer quickly, quote honestly, and say so when we cannot supply.
